# Constitution of the Internal Equipment Inventory

## Mission

Help internal staff know which equipment is recorded and who has custody of it, by maintaining a small inventory that supports recording items, searching by label and recording custody.

## Vision

Make equipment identification and custody information available to internal staff when they need it. A time horizon is pending definition.

## Users and Needs

| Priority user | Situation or need | Evidence or source | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Internal staff who record equipment or its custody | Need a shared record of equipment and custody and a way to locate an item by its label | Supplied task: small internal equipment inventory limited to item recording, label search and custody recording | Supplied direction; document approval pending |

## Product Principles

### PRI-001 — Keep the inventory focused

- **Criterion:** Prioritize a small, understandable record of equipment and custody.
- **Application:** Evaluate proposals against the three supplied purposes: item recording, label search and custody recording. Additional capabilities require a new scope decision.
- **Status:** proposed
- **Source or decision:** Supplied task; approval of this wording is pending.

### PRI-002 — Make custody understandable

- **Criterion:** Equipment and custody information should help internal staff understand which item they are looking at and who has custody.
- **Application:** Keep decisions aligned with clear identification and custody information; do not expand into purchasing or other operational systems.
- **Status:** proposed
- **Source or decision:** Supplied task; approval of this wording is pending.

## Product Objectives

### OBJ-001 — Find recorded equipment and understand its custody

- **Outcome:** Internal staff can locate recorded equipment by its label and understand its recorded custody.
- **Users or needs addressed:** Internal staff described in Users and Needs.
- **Relevant principles:** PRI-001, PRI-002.
- **Status:** proposed
- **Source or decision:** Supplied purpose and boundaries; document approval pending.

## Success Criteria

### EXI-001 — Useful equipment and custody information

- **Objective:** OBJ-001.
- **Metric or observable signal:** Internal staff can use the inventory to identify recorded equipment and understand its custody when needed. The measurement method is pending definition.
- **Baseline:** Pending measurement.
- **Target:** Pending definition by the responsible person or role.
- **Time frame:** Pending definition.
- **Evidence source:** Future observations from internal staff; no results have been collected.
- **Criterion status:** proposed

## Boundaries and Exclusions

- **Boundaries:** Internal equipment inventory limited to recording items, searching by label and recording custody.
- **Out of scope:** Purchases, discovery and integrations.
- **Status and source:** Boundaries supplied in the task. This document is an unapproved draft; the task authorizes preparing it for review and does not approve its final wording.

## Governance and Review

- **Who proposes changes:** Internal staff may raise needs; the formal proposing role is pending confirmation.
- **Who approves them:** Pending identification of the responsible person or role.
- **When to review:** When the intended users, equipment information needs or supplied boundaries change, or when evidence challenges the objectives or criteria.
- **Approval rule:** Changes to the mission, vision, principles, objectives, success criteria or boundaries require an explicit decision from the responsible person or role. An editorial correction does not change approved commitments.
- **Maintenance rule:** A new feature alone does not justify changing this constitution. Surface conflicts before executing affected work and record the decision that resolves them.
